title: The Black Velvet Band
commons_title: File:Black Velvet Band - Celtic Aire - United States Air Force Band.mp3
composition: traditional Irish street ballad, 19th century; public domain
credit: Performance by Celtic Aire, United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
lyrics: In a neat little town they call Belfast
Apprenticed to trade I was bound
And many an hour of sweet happiness
I spent in that neat little town
Her eyes they shone like diamonds
I thought her the queen of the land
And her hair hung over her shoulder
Tied up with a black velvet band
